description: This file contains functions for converting Slack import data, including timestamp conversion, channel name normalization, user mention and channel mention replacements, and message markup transformations.

methods.name: slackConvertTimeStamp
methods.description: Converts a Slack timestamp string to milliseconds since epoch.

methods.name: slackConvertChannelName
methods.description: Normalizes Slack channel names, handling special characters and invalid characters.

methods.name: slackConvertUserMentions
methods.description: Replaces Slack user mention syntax with '@' mentions in posts.

methods.name: slackConvertChannelMentions
methods.description: Replaces Slack channel mention syntax with '~' mentions in posts.

methods.name: slackConvertPostsMarkup
methods.description: Converts Slack message markup (URLs, bold, strikethrough, blockquotes) to Markdown format.
